name: Ladi Wen
text: Ladi Wen, the White Lady, is a spectral woman robed in white. Welsh oral tradition knows her well. As a common bogy she was used to warn children about bad behavior. She was most often seen at Hollantide, the night from 31 October to 1 November.

attributes.attribute: spectral White Lady of Welsh tradition
